claims.statement: CEMS activation EMSR927 identifies Flood in Nepal as a Flood / Flash flood event.
CEMS reports activation-level impact statistics: Built-up area [ha]: 11, Identified buildings [No.]: 3922, Population [No.]: 5900, Roads [km]: 56, max_extent: 940.
CEMS lists 5 AOI products: 4 finished and 1 waiting or in production.

data_gaps: Bharatpur GRA product is waiting for data.

findings.message: CEMS activation EMSR927 was retrieved from the public Rapid Mapping API.
CEMS activation is still open, so AOIs, products, and statistics may change.
1 AOI product(s) are waiting or still in production.

snapshots.license_note: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activation metadata is publicly accessible and must be cited as source data.

results.name: Flood in Nepal
results.reason: On the 26 August 2026, a flash flood reportedly triggered by a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) in Nepal has caused significant damage in Rasuwa District. There is a 7 m-deep water level recorded by monitoring stations. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
